contractSource: config/tools.ts description: "Convert acres to square feet". The on-page banner states "1 acre = 43,560 sq ft" and the settings panel states the formula "sq ft = acres x 43,560".
groundTruth: The international acre is defined as 4,840 square yards. A square yard is 3 ft x 3 ft = 9 square feet. So 1 acre = 4,840 x 9 = 43,560 square feet exactly. The same figure follows from the historical definition of 1 chain x 1 furlong = 66 ft x 660 ft = 43,560 sq ft. This constant is definitional and is not taken from the site's source.

cases.note: The definitional case. If this is wrong, the conversion factor itself is wrong.
cases.derivation: 1 acre is defined as 4,840 square yards; 1 square yard = 3 ft x 3 ft = 9 sq ft; 4,840 x 9 = 43,560. So 1 acre must display 43,560 sq ft.

cases.note: Linear scaling, and a value large enough to expose comma-grouping bugs.
cases.derivation: Area scales linearly with the acre count: 5 x 43,560 sq ft = 217,800 sq ft. Computed by hand: 43,560 x 5 = 217,800.

cases.note: A fractional input, the common residential lot size.
A decimal input that must not be truncated to an integer before multiplying.
cases.derivation: 2.5 x 43,560 = (2 x 43,560) + (0.5 x 43,560) = 87,120 + 21,780 = 108,900 sq ft. If the tool truncated 2.5 to 2 it would show 87,120 instead.

cases.note: The precision selector must change the displayed decimals without changing the value.
cases.derivation: Rounding 43,560 to 0 decimal places leaves 43,560 unchanged, because the exact value is an integer. Selecting 0 decimals must therefore still display 43,560 and must not alter the magnitude.

cases.note: Zero is a legitimate input, not an error. Asserted positively on the result card, because the page also carries a static reference table that lists the non-zero conversions.
cases.derivation: 0 acres encloses no land, so the area is 0 x 43,560 = 0 sq ft. Any non-zero figure on the result card, or a NaN, would be wrong.

cases.note: Three orders of magnitude above the nominal case, where comma grouping and float precision both matter.
cases.derivation: 100 x 43,560 = 4,356,000 sq ft. By hand: 43,560 x 100 shifts the decimal two places, giving 4,356,000.
